title: Coding Interview Pattern Practice
summary: Practice patterns through 18 existing guided questions and the BFS/DFS lessons, then review original array-state contracts and selected backtracking with a bounded keypad dictionary. Explain invariants, compare alternatives and choose a difficulty. Full backtracking and comprehensive dynamic programming are outside this path; it is not a complete interview syllabus or hiring guarantee.
audience: Developers strengthening coding interview reasoning across foundation, practitioner and selected senior examples. Company collections are reported public preparation, not official question banks.

units.title: Lookup, Stacks And Pointers
units.summary: Practice lookup ownership, nested delimiters, one-deletion budgets and in-place pointer updates. Explain the invariant before choosing a faster approach.

units.title: Windows And Prefix Counts
units.summary: Distinguish a contiguous distinct window from prefix-sum counting with negative values. State why a window cannot replace the prefix-count contract.

units.title: Intervals, Top K And Binary Partitions
units.summary: Compare interval merging with room allocation, choose heap or frequency buckets for top K, then study the senior binary-partition median example.

units.title: Tree Coordinates And Serialization
units.summary: Clarify column-order tie rules before comparing traversals. Preserve null positions when encoding and reconstructing the senior tree example.

units.title: Recency And Expiry State
units.summary: Study senior examples with different cache contracts: recency eviction and caller-clock expiry. Compare the simpler reference approach with its optimized alternative.

units.title: Traversal, Dependencies And Path Cost
units.summary: Review existing BFS/DFS lessons and checkpoints, then compare components, dependency cycles, equal-cost moves and non-negative weighted paths.

units.title: Array State Reviews
units.summary: Test nonempty/tie rules, validated cyclic placement and strictly greater successors with original bounded oracles.

units.title: Bounded Dictionary Backtracking
units.summary: Validate a closed dictionary, distinguish prefixes from words, restore branch state and compare trie search with an independent scan.
